title: Finance Calculation: Amount Refunded on a Second Kestrel Rx Savings Club Fee Charge (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
The refund of a second Kestrel Rx Savings Club fee charge under the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs is the amount booked on that charge, with no courtesy credit. The figure is stated to the cent, rounded half up.

The second charge is the later-dated of the two fee charges carrying the same membership term, and the amount booked is the amount the fee history shows on that charge.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Fee history of the term | Second charge | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| Two charges of $20.00 | the later-dated $20.00 charge | $20.00 |
| Two charges of $35.00 | the later-dated $35.00 charge | $35.00 |
| A $17.00 charge followed by a later $17.00 charge | the later $17.00 charge | $17.00 |
